CustomField.description: When checked, the daily, weekly and monthly digest batches send nothing for this neighbourhood (boundary Account) and log a Skipped row instead. Use while collecting signups before launch. Independent of Active__c, which controls signup routing.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to stop digest emails for this neighbourhood, e.g. while collecting signups before launch. Signups still route here if Active is Yes.
CustomField.label: Pause Digest Emails
